displayName: Chewy Product Data API - Prices, Autoship, Ratings
description: Chewy product data as structured JSON - search chewy.com or browse a category, 36 products per page, with the one-time price, Autoship price and discount, strike-through and per-unit price, rating and rating count; and read one product with list, offer and MAP price, first-Autoship price and savings cap, star distribution, review count, GTIN, specifications, ingredients and feeding details, promotions and every size and flavor variant. 2 endpoints, 10 credits each.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
